requirement.functional.name: OrderService
requirement.functional.@statement: Every placed order is recorded before payment is attempted
requirement.functional.@counterexample: A payment attempted against an order that was never stored
requirement.functional.@description:
Recording first is what lets a failed payment be retried.

# Why first

A payment with no order is a refund nobody can trace.

requirement.functional.name: OrderRecord
requirement.functional.@statement: An order records what was bought, for how much, and when: placed | paid
requirement.functional.@counterexample: An order row that cannot say who placed it

requirement.functional.name: TranscribableReference
requirement.functional.@statement:
An order carries a reference a customer can read
down a phone line
requirement.functional.@counterexample: A reference that is a raw uuid

requirement.functional.name: OrderExpiry
requirement.functional.@statement: An unpaid order carries the instant it stops being reservable
requirement.functional.@counterexample: Stock held indefinitely against an order nobody paid for

requirement.architectural.name: MoneyIsExactMinorUnits
requirement.architectural.@statement: Monetary amounts are stored as exact integer minor units, never as floating point
requirement.architectural.@counterexample: A cent that disappears when a total is split three ways

requirement.functional.name: GuestCheckout
requirement.functional.@statement: A visitor can check out without an account
requirement.functional.@counterexample: An order with no way to reach the person who placed it
